result:
If I could change one thing, I’d make basic education and reliable information universally accessible to everyone.

Not just school, but the ability to learn critical thinking, digital literacy, and practical life skills anywhere in the world, in a language and format people can actually use. A lot of the biggest problems we face—poverty, polarization, bad health decisions, corruption, fear of others—get worse when people can’t access trustworthy knowledge.

If people had that foundation, they’d have a much better chance to improve everything else themselves.
